about.title: Made in Çankırı, bottled in Çankırı
about.body: Çankırı Gazozu is produced in its own factory in the Orta district of Çankırı. Every stage of production, from the water to the bottle, happens here. No contract manufacturing, no production line shipped in from another city — this soda really is Çankırı's.

page.title: Our Soda Factory in Çankırı
page.lead: At our factory in Orta, Çankırı, soda is still made the way you remember it: in glass bottles, with a traditional recipe, without rushing.

sections.heading: A soda factory in Çankırı
sections.body: Çankırı Gazozu is produced in the city whose name it carries. Our factory is in the Orta district of Çankırı, and the entire production — bottling, carbonation and labelling — happens here. While many local brands moved production to other cities, we kept ours in Çankırı. The reason is not only sentimental: the taste of soda is directly tied to the water it is made with.

sections.heading: Traditional production, unchanged recipe
sections.body: Our soda has been made with the same recipe since the day we opened. We never left the glass bottle; glass protects carbonation and aroma far better than plastic. Bottles are washed and inspected before filling, and every batch is checked before shipping.

sections.heading: Cornelian cherry soda: a first from Çankırı
sections.body: The cornelian cherry grows in Çankırı's own soil and has become identified with the city. The idea of making soda from this fruit was born here, and cornelian cherry soda was produced for the first time in our factory. The natural tartness of the fruit balances the sweetness of the soda, creating a taste unlike any classic fruit soda.

sections.heading: Where to find us
sections.body: Çankırı Gazozu is sold in markets, restaurants and kiosks across Çankırı and its districts. If you would like to sell our products in your own city, fill in the dealership form and our team will call you to explain the terms.
